#summary Access management with chair/access package

= Example: =

== Configuration file ==

{{{
<?xml version='1.0'?>
<groups>
    <group name='Guest'>
        <resource name='Book'>
            <action name='Get_Title' />
            <action name='Get_Page' />
        </resource>
    </group>
    <group name='Publisher'>
        <resource name='Book'>
            <action name='Get_Title' />
            <action name='Get_Page' />
            <action name='Change_Title' />
            <action name='Delete' />
        </resource>
    </group>
</groups>
}}}


== Code: ==

{{{
/* For usage of contexts we have to add this line to the used context configuration file:
<contexts>
    <context name='Example'>
        <method name='getACL' class='Simple_ACL' method='__construct' />
    </context>
</contexts>
*/

class Example
{
    public function run()
    {
        $context = Context_Manager::getContext(__CLASS__);
        $acl = $context->getACL();

        $acl->load('configs/acl.xml');
        $groups = $acl->getGroupsByTargetAndAction('Book', 'Get_Title');
        
        $user = $context->getUser();
        $userGroups = $user->getGroups();
        
        if (count(array_intersect($groups, $userGroups))) {
            /* user can execute Get_Title action on Book resource */
        } else {
            /* user group do not have access to Get_Title on Book */
        }
    }
}

$example = new Example();
$example->run();

}}}
